meta.title: Robotics Engineer
meta.tagline: Design and program intelligent machines that interact with the physical world.
meta.description: Robotics engineers combine mechanical design, electronics, control systems and software to build robots. They work on perception, motion planning, control algorithms and human-robot interaction.
